narrative.overview: Jawara Teknik combines industrial reliability with modern architectural hospitality. The design language avoids cheap AI-generated novelty, excessive cartoonish badges, and muddy gradients in favor of structural gridlines, crystal-clear typographic hierarchy, and tactile, high-contrast surfaces.

rules.name: The Rarity of Emerald Rule
rules.body: The emerald green accent is strictly reserved for live WhatsApp actions, real-time availability badges, and confirmed guarantees. It never appears on arbitrary text or decorative dividers.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: No text element may ever drop below a 7:1 contrast ratio against its direct background on mobile or desktop. Faded low-contrast gray text is strictly forbidden.

rules.name: The Tabular Pricing Rule
rules.body: All numeric pricing values must utilize tabular numbers to maintain strict vertical alignment across columns.

rules.name: The Hairline Boundary Rule
rules.body: Card containers must rely primarily on a 1px solid hairline boundary rather than a diffuse dark shadow to define their boundary.

dos: Do maintain strict minimum contrast ratio of 7:1 for all readable text.
Do use tabular numbers (tnum) for all currency amounts, times, and horsepower ratings.
Do provide explicit bilingual keys (data-i18n) on every newly authored visual string.
Do respect user preferences for reduced motion on all scroll reveals and modal transitions.
donts: Don't use low-contrast light gray text (text-slate-400 or #94A3B8) for body copy or card descriptions.
Don't use giant, arbitrary border radii (rounded-3xl or rounded-[40px]) on rectangular content cards.
Don't apply muddy multi-color linear gradients across entire card backgrounds.
Don't invent fake testimonials or fabricate unverified technical accreditations.
